page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-192-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance within the c4d server family. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system is equipped with 1512.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. No GPUs are included in this configuration. Although the local storage size is designated as None, the system configuration references nvme ssd as the local storage type.

This instance represents a high-density resource profile designed for enterprise-scale workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio, this server is positioned for memory-intensive applications, large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, and heavy enterprise workloads that require substantial memory capacity alongside massive parallel processing capabilities.
